Achievements

The Debate Federation of Ukraine turns 10!

6 May 2021, 5 min read

Today our organisation celebrates its first big anniversary! Day by day, side by side, every debater has made the history of the DFU.

It all began back in 2011 with the federation's first founding conference. Then a few dozen people decided that debate in Ukraine should be. Today we have more than 1,000 members, 16 branches and a club in Krakow, and we are not stopping!

In June 2012 the first debate tournament for DFU members, the Federation Cup, took place in Vinnytsia. Tournaments were rare then. Today our debaters can compete for the title every week, meet friends and travel around Ukraine, and even when we cannot meet in person, we train, debate and win online. We are proud of it!

Recognition

Our team has started working with the Ministry of Youth and Sports of Ukraine, the Embassy of Finland, the International Renaissance Foundation and other organisations, and city and regional councils support our events. More than 15,000 people in Ukraine have heard of us through debate events. And this is only the beginning!

Debate changes the life of everyone who comes to it. And each of you changes yourself and the society around you, and makes tomorrow's world better.

Karyna Kuznietsova, President of the DFU
